semgrepRulesetAssessment.trap: TRAP 4 - Semgrep has no bundled Solidity SECURITY ruleset.
semgrepRulesetAssessment.verdict: NO SECURITY VALUE. Confirmed for the THIRD consecutive run on this project. Every one of the 40 results is severity INFO and every result's own metadata categorises it as best-practice or performance - not security. Zero WARNING and zero ERROR rules fired because the ruleset contains no Solidity vulnerability detectors to fire.
semgrepRulesetAssessment.explicitStatement: A clean or near-clean Semgrep run on this repository is evidence of NOTHING and MUST NOT be cited or summarised as security coverage. What actually executed is a 50-rule gas-and-style linter. 39 of the 40 results are severity-mapped to discard; the single survivor (use-ownable2step) is retained ONLY as third-tool corroboration of 4naly3er L-2/L-12 in normalised finding SA-014, never on its own merit.
semgrepRulesetAssessment.noBetterRulesetAvailable: No Solidity security ruleset exists in the Semgrep registry - the same conclusion reached independently in run-01 and run-02.
semgrepRulesetAssessment.coverageImplication: Effective SECURITY tool count on this project is THREE (Slither, Aderyn, 4naly3er), not four. Any statement of the form 'four tools found nothing' would be false.
